title: policy_stream
description:
Client -> robot. Drives the robot's always-on policy streamer, which pushes camera frames to a policy runner.

Capability-gated: advertise "policy_stream" in ack.capabilities. A robot without it ignores these frames silently and no reply ever arrives, so a client MUST time out rather than wait forever. Do not pipeline commands. Replies carry no correlation id, and the control channel is UNORDERED as well as unreliable (ordered=false, max-retransmits=0 on both stacks), so FIFO waiter-matching in a client is a convention with no transport guarantee behind it -- one lost or reordered reply desynchronises it.

dest.description: Where frames are pushed. Meaningful on start.

target.description: Destination address for `dest`, when it is not implied by the session.
